attributes.board_name: Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses directly related to patient care or management of the dental practice; CE units as determined by the course sponsor; home study with post-test and certificate accepted. The Board does not pre-approve courses. Not accepted: money management, investments, consultant time, organizational business meetings.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Requirement starts January 1 of the calendar year after licensure and is pro-rated if not at the start of a reporting period.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours above the minimum do not carry forward.
rules.alternatives: Full-time graduate study, internship or residency in dentistry/dental hygiene fulfils the requirement for that period (Board must be notified). Deployed service members and spouses are fully exempt until 180 days after return.
rules.audit_note: Signed list of CE hours on Board forms at the end of each reporting period; audits at the end of each period. Keep records at least 3 years after the period ends.
rules.legal_basis: Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners Rules, Article XIV (Minimum Continuing Education for Dentists and Dental Hygienists); Ark. Code Ann. 17-82-310

topics.who: Hygienists with a local anesthesia certificate: current healthcare-provider BLS for its yearly renewal

rules.notes: Reporting period = two calendar years starting in an even year; licenses renew January 1 of even-numbered years. 1 CEU = at least 50 minutes. Hygienists with a local anesthesia certificate need current healthcare-provider BLS for its yearly renewal.
